blocks.h2: Shower Repairs in Arlington Heights Homes
blocks.intro: Arlington Heights bathrooms span more than 80 years, and the shower valve tells you which era you're in.

items.body: Original bathrooms from the 1950s and 1960s often have separate hot and cold handles. They can be rebuilt, but parts can be hard to find. Sometimes a new valve is the better choice.
Older valves don't balance pressure, so a flush elsewhere in the house can turn the shower hot or cold. A pressure-balancing valve fixes it.
In homes with original galvanized supply pipe, rust narrows the lines over time. If the shower and the bathroom sink are both weak, the pipe may be the problem.
Original 1950s and 1960s tile can be hard to match. That's one more reason we work through the trim opening whenever we can.

blocks.h2: Shower Repair Questions From Arlington Heights Homeowners

items.q: Can you fix a dripping shower without opening the wall?
items.preview: Usually. Cartridges and washers come out through the trim.
items.answer: Usually. Replacing a worn cartridge or washer is done through the trim opening. Replacing the whole valve sometimes needs a small access panel, often from the back side of the wall.

items.q: Why does my shower go hot or cold when someone flushes?
items.preview: Your valve isn't balancing pressure, or the balancing part is worn.
items.answer: When a toilet fills, it pulls cold water away from the shower. A pressure-balancing valve adjusts for that. Older valves don't have one, and newer ones can wear out.

items.q: Can you replace an old three-handle shower valve?
items.preview: Yes. We can often do it with minimal tile work.
items.answer: Yes. Upgrading to a single-handle pressure-balancing valve is common in older Arlington Heights bathrooms. We'll explain how much tile work is needed before we start.

items.q: Why is my shower pressure so low?
items.preview: A clogged head, a worn cartridge or old pipe.
items.answer: Start with the showerhead, which can clog with mineral buildup. If a new head doesn't help, the cartridge or the supply pipe is likely the issue.

items.q: How much does shower repair cost in Arlington Heights?
items.preview: It depends on the valve and parts. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the valve, the parts and access. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
